[[File:Medial disdyakis triacontahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a medial disdyakis triacontahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''medial disdyakis triacontahedron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[uniform star polyhedron|uniform]] [[truncated dodecadodecahedron]]. It has 120 triangular faces.

== Proportions==
The triangles have one angle of <math>\arccos(-\frac{1}{10})\approx 95.739\,170\,477\,27^{\circ}</math>, one of <math>\arccos(\frac{3}{8}+\frac{11}{40}\sqrt{5})\approx 8.142\,571\,179\,89^{\circ}</math> and one of <math>\arccos(-\frac{3}{8}+\frac{11}{40}\sqrt{5})\approx 76.118\,258\,342\,85^{\circ}</math>. The [[dihedral angle]] equals <math>\arccos(-\frac{9}{11})\approx 144.903\,198\,772\,42^{\circ}</math>. Part of each triangle lies within the solid, hence is invisible in solid models.
